text:
rachel: hi team :wave: I just finished my laptop setup. hitting a couple things — Okta shows 'no apps assigned' after SSO login, google drive doesn't show the team's folder, and my 1Password invite is still "pending". also tried to register my security key (fido) and it fails with "Registration failed". who should I ping?
it-support: hey rachel — welcome! can you confirm you logged in to Okta with your @redwood.com account (not personal)? also what's the exact error when you try the security key?
rachel: yep it's my company email. security key popup just says "Registration failed" then returns me to the dashboard. 1Password invite email arrived but clicking the link says "invalid or expired token".
onboarding-bot: Welcome rachel! If any of your provisioning needs manual fixes, please tag @it-support and include your employee ID. Docs: <https://redwood.internal/onboarding/start-here> :book: 
jeff: @rachel — curious if this is a SCIM/groupsync timing issue. Can you paste the output of this (in a DM is fine): `curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $OKTA_TOKEN" "https://api.okta.com/v1/users/rachel@redwood.com/apps" | jq '. | length'` — should return >0 if apps are assigned. If you're not comfortable running curl, we can check from our side.
rachel: not comfortable running that, sorry. can you check?
it-support: will do. also try clearing cookies or open an incognito window and login to Okta again — sometimes stale sessions show old state. for 1Password i'll re-send the invite after we confirm your account ID.
devon: tagging identity team — @jeff please check SCIM provisioning for rachel@redwood.com. i see a recent groupsync error in the job logs at 03:12 UTC referencing ldap:group-membership mismatch.
jeff: noted. i'm seeing user provisioned but group membership sync failed for group "eng-new-hires" — likely why Drive folder ACLs didn't inherit. i'll force a re-sync now and resend 1Password invite after success.
it-support: quick workaround for Drive: if someone on the team (e.g., your manager) shares the folder link directly we can grant access while identity finishes.
rachel: thanks — my manager shared the folder but still says "Request access" when I open.
jeff: gave you direct access manually; try again in a minute. also re-sent the 1Password invite to rachel@redwood.com (new token) — check spam.
rachel: ok 1Password link worked! and I can open the Drive folder now. security key registration still failing though — same message.
it-support: for the FIDO key, can you try these steps: 1) remove any leftover entries in Chrome under Settings -> Privacy -> Security -> Manage security keys; 2) fully reboot and try with Chrome/Edge latest; 3) if possible, try the key on another machine to confirm it's not hardware-faulty. if it still fails we'll issue a temporary app password for now.
rachel: trying step 1 now. thanks all :)
it-support: feel free to DM if step 3 fails and we'll ship a replacement key. closing loop: provisioning hiccup was groupsync failure, jeff forced resync, 1Password invite reissued, Drive ACL fixed. remaining: hardware key registration troubleshooting. :lock:
